common.sampleData: Demo mode: the apps and files shown here are examples, not from your PC. Real scanning is coming in the next versions.

home.subtitle: Here is what you can do to free up space.
home.appsText: Remove programs you don't use, along with the files they leave behind.
home.filesText: Old downloads, huge files, duplicates and forgotten installers.
home.leftoversText: Folders left behind by programs you already uninstalled.
home.mapText: See at a glance what takes up the most space.
home.quarantineTip: Temporary files and caches are deleted right away, because apps recreate them. Everything else goes to Quarantine for {days} days and you can restore it with one click.
home.quickCleanHint: Only what is safe, in one click.

quick.subtitle: I only remove what is safe. Anything that needs a look is up to you, whenever you like.
